messages:
sam: quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's page storm — want to lock owners/timelines for alert tuning and remediation handback. short list: 
- increase noisy thresholds for infra/high-cpu alerts (owner: katie) — target: 72h
- implement dedupe key for error-rate alerts (owner: jordan) — target: 1 week
- update paging policy: low-sev -> slack-only, medium -> oncall at daytime only (owner: matt) — target: 48h
- auto-suppress known flapping hosts via suppression rule + monitoring (owner: alyssa) — target: 2w
can owners ack and confirm they have queue + any blockers? cc @devops-bot for ticket creation :wave:

katie: ack, i'll take the cpu threshold. plan to bump the rule and run a 24h dry-run. will post exact rule change here when ready.

jordan: taking dedupe. question — do we want the dedupe key to be `job + error_signature` or `instance + error_signature`? job-level seems safer to avoid noise from ephemeral instances.

matt: i can do the paging policy update. two quick asks: 1) do we grandfather existing alerts for 2 weeks? 2) confirm hours for "daytime" (09:00-18:00 PT ok?).

alyssa: i can prototype the suppression rule. plan: create a metric `alerts.flap_count` and suppress when flap_count > 3 in 10m, then alert to a suppression channel. need a list of hosts to exclude (we should exclude infra-control-plane).

sam: answers: 
- jordan: go with `job + error_signature` for dedupe, that will reduce noise from autoscaling.
- matt: yes please grandfather for 14 days. daytime 09:00-18:00 PT works.
- alyssa: infra-control-plane excluded, i'll DM the list.

katie: here's the rule diff i'll test, dry-run tomorrow morning:
```
# old
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.8
# proposed
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.9
labels:
  severity: medium
```
will watch for regressions and report back.

jordan: noted — i'll add the dedupe key in the alert template: `dedupe_key: '{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}'`. timeline: PR by Thu, merge Fri, validate next Mon.

matt: will update paging policy doc and the oncall rota rules. PR up by EOD tomorrow. also will add a note to the runbook about what to do if suppressed but persistent.

devops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-2123 "Alert tuning follow-ups: CPU thresh, dedupe, paging policy, suppression" assigned to [katie, jordan, matt, alyssa] due 2026-05-12 :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: +1 on dedupe approach. can we add a quick smoke test for dedupe to the CI job?

alyssa: good call — i'll add a smoke job to the alerting-ci that fires a synthetic error and checks dedupe/suppression behavior. target: next Wed.

sam: sweet. i'll consolidate these into the postmortem action table and ping eng-ops later today. final checklist from this thread: 
- katie: rule bump dry-run (72h)
- jordan: dedupe PR (1w)
- matt: paging policy + grandfather PR (48h)
- alyssa: suppression prototype + CI smoke (2w)
if anyone needs more time, flag here. otherwise i'll close the loop on the ticket and mark owners. :thumbsup:
